title: Book Three · Chapter 168: The First Friday Pay
story:
On the first Friday of the new agreement, a customer arrives with a folded room plan.

He wants a small bookcase beside his window. There is a table near the same wall.

Ronan opens the plan on the counter. The man gives the wall length first, then the table size.

“Can you put it here?” he asks.

Ronan follows the clear floor space with his finger.

“Which way does your table face?” he asks.

The man turns the little paper shape.

Now its long side reaches toward the window. There is less room than the first drawing showed.

“I drew it the other way,” the man says.

Ronan gets another sheet and puts it beside the plan. He and the man try both positions with a small piece of card.

The man sits closer to look.

“That is how we use it.”

Ronan marks the space beside the window. Mr Sun comes to check the sizes and discuss the bookcase.

Ronan puts the first drawing aside. The changed one stays in front of Mr Sun. Ronan writes today's date on the new page.

After the man leaves, Dad looks at the little card table.

“A light piece to move.”

“No tea on it yet.”

Dad smiles and takes the checked drawing to Mr Sun. Ronan clears the counter for the next visitor.

At twelve, Mr Sun pays the first nine yuan. Ronan has finished Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, three hours each morning.

He counts the money and writes the date. At home, he puts the nine yuan in his work envelope.

The twenty-seven becomes thirty-six. The parents' one hundred and his older twenty and a half stay in their own places.

Anna comes to meet him after lunch. She has finished one clean drawing copy and wants to show him a window line.

Ronan washes the last pencil mark from his thumb. Then he takes the drawing.

“No work fingers,” he says.

“Pencils live in my folder too.”

She shows him her own grey fingertip, and both laugh.

They take the drawing to the yard bench. Anna explains the front view. Ronan asks about the room behind the window.

Mum passes with a finished coat. She stops to look. Anna holds the drawing up for Mum.

Ronan moves along the bench to make room. Mum sits beside them, and Anna begins her explanation again with the wide space near the door.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

face＝朝向；discuss＝讨论；fingertip＝指尖；bookcase＝书柜。

## 理解问题

1. 顾客的桌子朝向怎样影响书柜空间？Ronan如何把旧图与更正图分清？
2. 首周实际领到多少钱？工资信封余额变为多少，其余两份钱有没有自动增加？

## 读句子

**The twenty-seven becomes thirty-six.**

拆开看：The twenty-seven / becomes / thirty-six.

原有的二十七元／增加为／三十六元。
